address.displayAddress: Ginther's Swirls Ice Cream, 11036 International Dr, Orlando, FL 32821, USA

publicReviewsPreview.reviewText: Large portions for a great price. The dole whip was amazing, and my daughter loved the cookies and cream.

DoorDash orders are discriminated upon. Instead of providing fresh soft serve ice cream, which is why I pay the premium price, they have pre-packaged FROZEN SOLID quarts, which will be hard as rock and take forever to melt, never ever qualifying as soft serve.
If I wanted frozen solid ice cream I'd get it at the stores: I'd save money: I want swirl soft serve for delivery as it is supposed to.
I spoke with the manager and they told me that "that is how it is for delivery" and specifically for Door Dashers! And I quote: "There is no reason that you would not get frozen pre-packaged ice cream if you order delivery, unless we ran out of pre-packaged quarts". So, NO SOFT SERVE for door dash and rude explanation from manager.
It's ALWAYS amazing! Literally can't go wrong.
